name: Myra
description: Hybrid Hinglish Telegram chatbot with multi-userbot AutoChat: MongoDB similarity search first, AI fallback second, auto-training back into the database.

API_ID.description: Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).

OWNER_ID.description: Your numeric Telegram user id — this account gets /admin.

MONGO_URL.description: MongoDB that stores ONLY the chat/training brain (Word.WordDb). Free cluster: https://cloud.mongodb.com

BOT_MONGO_URL.description: OPTIONAL second MongoDB for everything the bot owns (users, chats, admins, userbot sessions, clones, settings, AI keys). Leave empty to reuse MONGO_URL.

GEMINI_API_KEYS.description: OPTIONAL. One or more Google Gemini API keys, comma separated (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). Rotated automatically. Empty = database-only mode.

OPENAI_API_KEYS.description: OPTIONAL. One or more OpenAI / ChatGPT keys, comma separated. Works with any OpenAI-compatible proxy when OPENAI_BASE_URL is set.

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Endpoint used by the OpenAI provider. Point it at your proxy for free keys.

AI_PROVIDER_ORDER.description: Which provider is asked first after the database misses.

AI_ENABLE.description: Enable the AI fallback at all (true/false).

USERBOT_AUTOCHAT_DEFAULT.description: Start every newly added userbot with AutoChat ON (true/false).
